definitions.gloss: poison gas; toxic gas; noxious gas
definitions.explanation: A gaseous substance that is harmful or deadly when inhaled. Used for both chemical weapons and naturally occurring toxic gases.

examples.japanese: {毒|どく}ガスに{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please be careful of toxic gas.

examples.japanese: {火山|かざん}から{毒|どく}ガスが{発生|はっせい}している。
examples.english: Toxic gas is being emitted from the volcano.

examples.japanese: {第一次|だいいちじ}{世界|せかい}{大戦|たいせん}で{初|はじ}めて{毒|どく}ガスが{兵器|へいき}として{使|つか}われた。
examples.english: Poison gas was first used as a weapon in World War I.

notes:
A compound of {毒|どく} (poison) + ガス (gas). Appears in both everyday safety contexts (volcanic emissions, chemical leaks) and historical/military discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毒|どく}ガス{攻撃|こうげき}: poison gas attack
- {毒|どく}ガスマスク: gas mask
- {毒|どく}ガスが{発生|はっせい}する: toxic gas is emitted
- {毒|どく}ガス{事件|じけん}: poison gas incident

RELATED TERMS:
- {有毒|ゆうどく}ガス: toxic gas (more formal/technical)
- {催涙|さいるい}ガス: tear gas
- {排気|はいき}ガス: exhaust gas
